After being a client of this location (Hialeah, FL) for approximately five years, I was extremely disappointed by the dismissive and disrespectful treatment we received. When I asked reasonable questions about the services and charges, no one offered a clear explanation. Instead, we were told that if we did not agree, we could simply leave. When we arrived, neither the veterinarian nor the staff came to speak with us. The lack of compassion, communication, and professionalism was unacceptable.
Glad we made your experience a good one—thanks for the review! 🧡 …

Hi Barbara, our aim is to provide a positive experience to everyone coming to our hospitals. We understand you were not satisfied and would like to follow up on your experience with us. Please reach out to BanfieldCares@banfield.com with the name and phone number on your account so we can try to address your concerns

Horrible! They sell you a wellness plan to make it seem as its helpful and it's just a way to earn a commitment with someone for their money not for the sake of your animal. Dr. Tracy Scola was very clear stating it was my luck that my dog was sick and gave me nasty attitude for no reason when I only asked her two questions. She did not introduce herself when she came in the room just came at me super aggressive. I am way younger than her and she intimidated me tremendously with her frightening looks and approach. My dog is big (boxer) and she looked at my dog in disgust did not make him feel comfortable at all. She then was dismissive and I said WHAT A HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE where she then proudly said OH WELL! Nasty! And I mean disgusting the way I was treated. I am short when I say horrible attitude to be a Vet extremely scary. In conclusion my dog is still sick or maybe worse. I got an invoice for a EAR/NOSE/EYE exam as to where those where never performed. THEY DID NOT EVEN GREET MY DOG; LET ALONE TOUCH HIM. I have made the proper communications needed to handle this matter accordingly.

I love Banfield Hospital but the Miramar location. Everyone is polite and friendly. Completely opposite from this Hialeah location. Staff is rude and they talk to you like if you were their enemy. Their phone customer service is terrible. The lady on the phone screamed and treated me like a child. This location should try to have the same customer service Miramar has. Very disappointing

Don't go here. People will attack you as if you did something wrong to your animal and their wellness plan is a contract that will require you to pay in order to cancel. Went to the hospital twice and to cancel my plan they want 500 dollars

If I could describe this place properly, I wouldn't give it even one star. They deceive you with the friendly reception staff, but the veterinarian in charge acts irresponsibly. After harming a healthy pet, they wash their hands of the consequences of their malpractice. I took them a healthy pet, and they returned a sick and blind one. All they cared about was money; they're good at taking it from you. They use your love for your pet to treat you like an ATM. I don't recommend taking your pets there. Run away.
A big thank you for your pawsome review! 🐾 We hope to see you again soon. …

Going to take my dogs elsewhere.

Next week I'm going back to get my calluses fixed and my armpits waxed. Everything's wonderful; who would have thought I'd end up eating a stew with drool on it?

I adopted a rescue Yorkie 6 months ago and I was looking for a new veterinarian given I wasn't pleased with the first one I took her too. I took came across the offer for a free first time visit to Banfield in Hialeah and decided to give it a try. I was pleasantly surprised by the kind staff and the attention they gave me and my dog. They weren't trying to hustle me into anything and were professional. I will definitely return.
Thanks for the 5 stars and for partnering with us for your pet’s health!

I want to take this time, and I don't usually do this, but I can't let this opportunity pass without warning everyone who has a pet—and knows what they mean to us—not to make the mistake of falling into the hands of this catastrophic place. They don't care about the life of an animal; all they care about is money. The doctor is an unscrupulous scammer. I took my sick dog in, and when I took her out, she was worse. He just wanted me to leave her until 6 pm when they closed so he could charge me more without actually treating her. It's the worst place you could ever visit.

I lover this place every time I go there every question that I have they always give me good answers and the take care of of my dog really good I’m so satisfied with all the staff they treat me and my dog like family I strongly recommend to all the pet owners thank you for your service
I've been taking my German Shepherd, Daniela, to this place for 5 years now, and so far everything has gone well. I have nothing negative to add.

We bring our two cats here and it's always a great experience. No stress for us. Staff is kind and polite, and very thorough in explaining everything to us. We no longer live as close to this location as we'd like but we will always drive all the way here from Broward.

I think that comment is out of place. It's incredible how they can contradict the testimonials, and there are years of wonderful testimonials about this place and especially about my veterinarian. Thank you for everything, Dr. Roberto. You are an instrument of the Most High for my dogs and my family. Thank you again for your life. Amen.

I am very happy with my Doctor Roberto. He does blood tests, including pancreas, kidney, and liver tests, every six months because my dog ​​is 15 years old. I am a cautious woman; I would never wait until the last minute to rush. I don't hold back with my dogs; they are my children, and I love them. I always get their tests done on time. Thank you, doctors. ☺️🐾 I don't agree with that review that was posted against this place. I think it was time to graduate. We are all born to die, but for that, I recommend blood tests, ultrasounds, etc., done on time. I am very ashamed that people speak badly of this place and especially of my veterinarian who has saved thousands of lives. I am a volunteer at the Miami Shelter, and the 13 commissioners bring their little angels to the hands of this place, and the veterinarians are a blessing from God. I ask God for holy repentance for that unfair comment! Amen

Being in the medical field myself , I will write a thorough review on what banfield stand for and my experience their with my dog as of  january 2025 the contract ends and I have canceled the renewal , the service i had was horrendous brought my dog in for a check up and the doctors assistant came In. i ask a few questions and the assistant was lost in space she grabbed my dog and took it to the back not one time did I see the doctor himself nor did he present himself or the type of treatment my dog would recieved everything was done through the assistant and no explanation of any sort when push comes to shove all the doctor cares about is money and adding extra exams on their that your dog doesn't need . If your dog comes in for 1 thing your suppose to treat the problem and not add exams that are irrelevant banfield sadly has become a gimmick of business transaction and money driven they don't care for your dogs well being when you sign the contract it clearly states even if your dog "dies" you are bound to continue payment until contract is finished re read that last part and let that sink in , alot of time banfield doesn't have required medicine either , I sincerely hope everyone keeps their dogs far away from this place and look for an alternative.

This complaint is going to the Cuban Hispanic male vet they have there. These are the traits he displayed on my first meeting with him: very unprofessional, unorganized, egomaniac, lost, and rude. He talks to you like you’re dumb and doesn’t answer your questions correctly. He said we would be paying zero dollars for our visit because they made me bring my cat in for an all day checkup and did zero tests on her just for the front office lady to tell me that I do have to pay a fee. I was astonished by how lost the man was.

He doesn’t listen and interrupts people when they’re speaking. When I got there he was fighting with the lady before me, I began to learn why. I can tell that the nurses and front office lady’s are tired of defending him. They also can’t stand him and it’s perfectly clear why.
Excellent service. Prompt, caring, and dedicated. Truly a professional team, from the front desk staff to the doctors and all the assistants. 5 stars!

She did not even know what to do went inside then came out and said it is just to mix with water you could have done that I said to her how would I know that with no instructions on the box that say so, I mean not even she knew what to do and she works there she had to go inside and obviously ask someone inside she is very rude and have no knowledge why is she working there. I am glad with the doctor and the nurse because my dog urine is no more stinky but at the front desk they should really have people more friendly and knowledgeable.
